facts.text: Tim is currently learning German and finds it challenging but enjoyable.

evidence.quote: I'm learning German now - tough but fun.
Learning German has been tough but worth it.

facts.text: John knows some German and Spanish, and he believes that knowing these languages makes travel easier.

evidence.quote: I know a bit of it [German] myself and Spanish, it makes travel so much easier.

facts.text: Tim mentions that the structure of German is easier for him because he previously studied French in high school.

evidence.quote: I like the structure of the language, it's much easier when I took French in high school.

facts.text: John started learning Spanish recently and believes it offers personal and professional opportunities.

evidence.quote: I've always wanted to learn Spanish. I just started with it. It's such a useful language with many personal and professional opportunities!
